# Packages whose high or critical advisories the Supply Chain workflow accepts,
# with the reason and what it would take to clear them.
#
# One package name per line. An advisory against anything NOT listed here fails
# the build, so this file is the complete set of known, accepted risk — and
# changing it is a tracked edit that goes through review.
#
# Every entry should say why it is here and what closes it. An entry with no
# path to removal is an entry nobody will ever revisit.

# @stellar/stellar-sdk 14.6.1 depends on toml 5.x, which carries several
# unfixed DoS and prototype-pollution advisories. npm's only fix path is
# stellar-sdk 17, three majors up, and the XDR codec API changed shape in
# between: `TransactionMeta.v1()`, the `.switch()` accessors and the callable
# array arms all became plain discriminated-union properties. That is 27 type
# errors across src/footprint/extractor.ts, src/xdr/decoder.ts, src/xdr/types.ts
# and src/rpc/fallback-client.ts — a migration that deserves its own pull
# request rather than riding along with unrelated work.
#
# Reachability: this project imports only `xdr` from the SDK. The toml parser
# is SEP-1 stellar.toml handling, which nothing here calls, so the advisories
# are not on a code path this repository executes.
#
# Closes when: stellar-sdk is migrated to 17.x.
@stellar/stellar-sdk
toml
